body: IBA 1.9 mirror — Q-DISPOSITION clarified. Canonical authority: BIG #703/5971926463. Determination: preserve full canonical reason set, derive exactly one boundary-specific primary_visible_disposition. Privacy is an outer projection guard; for authorized consumers visible precedence is INVALID_REJECTED > CONFLICT_HOLD > TERMINAL_RETAINED > JUSTIFIED_NOT_APPLICABLE > RELEVANCE_UNKNOWN > DEFERRED_SUPPRESSED_WITH_REACTIVATION > KNOWN_REQUIRED. Minimal pairs resolve to PRIVACY_EXCLUDED for prohibited-recipient terminal history while preserving terminal state internally, and CONFLICT_HOLD for conflict+holder-UNKNOWN while preserving UNKNOWN as a secondary reason. No Founder decision required. Batch-C remains open pending Professor/STRATA oracle reconciliation. Mirror adds no authority.
